# System Atlas Directory

> Curated isometric atlases of real systems. People get a clickable map. Agents get a generated text twin and a JSON catalog.

This is a static GitHub Pages site. HTML is complete in the first response. No login is required for currently published atlases.

## When to use this

Use this directory when you need to understand how a system is put together: structures, data flows, decisions, and open questions. Start at the homepage, then open one atlas. Prefer SYSTEM.md when you want the whole design as text. Prefer the interactive map when a human will explore it.

Do not treat an atlas as live production state. It is a curated snapshot of a public repo or a known design.

## Atlases

Two atlases are published: QM and GEV.

- [QM atlas (interactive)](https://adg29.github.io/system-atlas-directory/qm/) — multiplayer agent harness for work
- [QM SYSTEM.md](https://adg29.github.io/system-atlas-directory/qm/SYSTEM.md) — generated text twin (decisions, structures, flows, questions)
- [QM source repo](https://github.com/yc-software/qm)
- [GEV atlas (interactive)](https://adg29.github.io/system-atlas-directory/gev/) — God's Eye View, photoreal 3D globe of live public signals
- [GEV SYSTEM.md](https://adg29.github.io/system-atlas-directory/gev/SYSTEM.md) — generated text twin (decisions, structures, flows, questions)
- [GEV source repo](https://github.com/bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view)

## Adding an atlas

Each atlas is a folder with `index.html` (the map), `SYSTEM.md` (the twin), and `atlas/data.mjs` (the only edited source). Rebuild with `node <folder>/atlas/build.mjs`. Then add the entry to `catalog.json`, `llms.txt`, `index.html`, `index.md`, and `sitemap.xml`.
